meta.scope: Iran Batch 2 — Oil & gas, sanctions/external constraints, labour, and early uniqueness densification under high-inflation and constrained external conditions.

candidates.title: Crude oil and condensate production statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Petroleum / OPEC / CBI related
candidates.description: Official and industry statistics on crude oil and condensate production. Iran ranks among the largest OPEC producers and holds some of the world’s largest proved reserves. Production and export volumes are heavily conditioned by sanctions regimes.
candidates.notes: Core hydrocarbon production node. Highest-centrality commodity uniqueness for Iran.

candidates.title: Oil and petroleum product export statistics
candidates.publisher: CBI / Ministry of Petroleum / shipping trackers
candidates.description: Export volumes and estimated values for crude and petroleum products. Export levels fluctuate sharply with sanctions enforcement, buyer willingness (notably China), and shipping constraints. Strait of Hormuz remains the primary route.
candidates.notes: Export-side densification of the oil cluster. Critical for external and fiscal balances.

candidates.title: Natural gas production and domestic consumption statistics
candidates.description: Statistics on dry natural gas production and domestic use. Iran is among the world’s largest gas producers (South Pars field central); most output is absorbed domestically rather than exported as LNG.
candidates.notes: Gas densification of the hydrocarbon cluster.

candidates.title: Sanctions and external economic constraints framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from CBI, fiscal and international sources
candidates.description: Recurring policy and analytical framing of the multi-layered sanctions regime (financial, energy, shipping, secondary sanctions) that constrains oil exports, access to the international financial system, and investment. Continuously cited across macro, fiscal and external analysis.
candidates.notes: High-centrality external-constraint frame that conditions almost every major economic series.

candidates.title: Labour force and unemployment statistics
candidates.description: Labour-force participation, employment and unemployment rates from household surveys. Youth and female labour-market outcomes are structurally important.

candidates.title: Poverty and living-standards statistics
candidates.publisher: SCI / World Bank-aligned and national monitoring
candidates.description: Poverty-rate and living-standards indicators. Poverty outcomes interact strongly with high inflation, subsidy policy and oil-revenue volatility.
candidates.notes: Core welfare measurement node under high-inflation conditions.

candidates.title: Iran oil–sanctions–labour densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from petroleum, CBI and SCI sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding oil production, oil exports, natural gas statistics, sanctions/external-constraints framing, labour force statistics and poverty/living-standards indicators into a coherent hydrocarbon–constraint–welfare layer.
